# Lip Sync AI

> > Lip Sync AI is an AI-powered lip synchronization platform that generates realistic lip-synced videos for content creators across YouTube, TikTok, Douyin, and other social media platforms.

The platform supports multi-speaker video translation, handles up to 6 faces simultaneously, and offers a dashboard for uploading images and audio to create AI-generated lip sync videos. Available in multiple languages including English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, German, French, Italian, Dutch, and Turkish.

## Key Topics

- Lip Sync AI
- AI lip synchronization
- Video translation
- Multi-speaker support
- Content creation
- YouTube optimization
- TikTok videos
- Douyin (抖音)
- Xiaohongshu (小红书)
- AI video generation

- Subscription plans
- Image and audio upload
- 6-face simultaneous processing
